base.description: The PDU as it ships. The removable mounting brackets, the cord retention brackets, the 14.17 mm spare buttons and the cable ties are in the box and are not drawn.

description: Eaton Tripp Lite series local metered PDU, 0U. A 1617 mm aluminium strip that hangs on two toolless mounting buttons beside a rack. It takes a single-phase 120 V feed through a fixed 10 ft cord that ends in a NEMA L5-30P (24 A, 2.88 kW). It feeds 24 NEMA 5-15/20R outlets in two separately breakered load banks of twelve. Between the banks are two two-digit meters, one for each bank. It has no switch and no network port.

name: pdumv30

banks.note: drawing - page 1 labels the outlets "B (BANK 1)" and "B (BANK 2)", the meters "A (BANK 1)" and "A (BANK 2)" and the breakers "C (BANK 1)" and "C (BANK 2)"; the isometric puts Bank 1 at the cord end. So the lower bank, nearest the cord, is bank 1 and the upper bank 2, each with the meter beside it and the breaker the callout names. Which of the two breaker plates is which is read from the order of the callouts, the lower one being bank 1 (an estimate). The SKU: "Two 20A breakers protect 12 outlets each".

breakers.note: drawing - each plate carries a push-to-reset breaker drawn as a round button in a square bezel. The part is common/breaker-push-reset@1, a class stand-in with its own estimates. The rating is the SKU's 20 A; the unit is single-phase, so each breaker feeds its 12 outlets alone.

capability.note: datasheet - the SKU: "Local metered", two meters that read each bank's current, and no outlet switching. The finest level metered is the bank, so `metering-scope: branch` and `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: drawing - page 2: 1617.44 [63.68] along the strip (front view), 55 [2.17] across, 43.5 [1.71] deep (side view), and 81.60 [3.21] over the cord retention bracket on the front. Page 1 and the SKU give 63.75 in long (1619.3) and the SKU 2.19 in wide (55.6); the 63.75 and the 2.19 are the rounded figures, and the 3.75 in the SKU and page 1 call the depth or length matches no dimension on page 2 (it is the 81.60 plus the buttons, about 95.3, on the likeliest reading, which no source states). The body stays the dimensioned 55 by 43.5. Weight 8 lb (3.63 kg), the SKU and page 1. Material aluminium, the SKU ("Durable Metal Case" on page 1).

dcim.note: the input is one power port, other (NEMA L5-30P), and each outlet a power outlet fed by it, `nema-5-20r` through its bank's breaker. No `feed_leg` is written: a single-phase PDU is on whatever leg its plug is on.

front.note: drawing - page 2 front view, y from the top end and across from the face's left edge, 55 across and centred 27.5. Bank 2 is the upper one: its 12 outlet boxes are 28.4 square at x 14.2, the first 39.2 from the top end and then every 40.95. The two meters follow, the first from 584.4 and the second from 663.6, each 21.6 across at x 16.9. Bank 1 is bank 2 moved down 723.2 (its first box at 762.4). Two breaker plates, about 39 by 43, lie at 1472.0 and 1517.3 with the breakers at their centres. The cord's strain relief is a loop about 19.4 across and 27 along at the foot, centred 25.5 across and 1594.5 down, with the cord leaving it to the side. Eight small screws are drawn, a pair at 1252.5, a pair at 1346.6, a pair at 1357.4 and a pair at 1451.5, each about 7.4 across at x 17.3 and 38.2, and four plate screws about 5.0 across at x 9.7 and 46.0, at 545.4 and 735.0 along the strip, on the edges of the meter block. The drawing prints no legends: no outlet numeral, no bank mark and no breaker name appears on page 2.

input.note: datasheet and drawing - "Input Connector L5-30P", "Cord Length 10 ft." (page 1), "NEMA L5-30P" (SKU), and detail E, the twist-lock plug face. The cord is attached. No power-port type of the two targets is held for an L5-30P, so `input-plug` is `other`, as the export writes it. 120 V single-phase, "Voltage 100-125V" and "30A" maximum capacity on page 1, agency de-rated to 24 A continuous (SKU).

meters.note: drawing - two meters, "2 Load Meters" on page 1, each a two-digit readout between two screws, with the SKU's "Set of 2 digital current meters ... for Bank 1 (20A max) and Bank 2 (20A max)". Each is eaton/tripplite-bank-meter@1. Colours are unchecked.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S SUBMITTAL DRAWING. The Tripp Lite PDUMV30 submittal drawing (201003014C, 2010, page 2) draws the front, the side and the rear, with detail A to E. Its views are vector, and every position was read off a 300 dpi render of page 2: 1.478 px per mm, from the strip's 2391 px between its end lines against the drawing's own 1617.44 (and 55 mm across), so a reading is good to about 0.7 mm. The pitch of the outlets is not dimensioned: it is measured, and reads 40.95 between the 12 boxes of a bank. Page 1's isometric names the banks and the callouts (A the meters, B the outlets, C the breakers) and is the second reading for which bank is which. No photograph of any face is held. The Tripp Lite single-phase stencil preview draws the strip dark grey with black outlets, which is a diagram and not a photograph, so every colour is unchecked.

mount.note: `rack-side`, the library's way to say a part stands beside an upright, with the two toolless buttons on its back (the drawing's rear view and detail A). `ru: 37` is the height it runs, 1617.44 / 44.45 = 36.4 rounded up; no source sells it by rack units. The removable mounting brackets (detail D) and the removable cord retention brackets (detail C) are in the box and are not drawn; the side view's comb of slots on the front is the retention bracket. Which side, and front or rear, is a lab placement's to say.

outlets.note: drawing - "5-15/20 OUTLET" on page 2 and "(24) 5-20R", "OUTPUT RECEPTACLES 5-15/20R" on the SKU. The library holds one part for the 5-15/20R strip's face, std/nema-5-20r@1, which takes a 5-15P and a 5-20P alike. The outlets are drawn with the T slot to the left and the earth hole down, as page 2 draws them. THE UNIT'S OWN NUMBERS ARE NOT KNOWN: no document held prints an outlet number, so the outlets are named outlet-1 to outlet-24 from the top, which is this model's numbering and not the unit's (gaps: outlet-numbers).

rear.note: drawing - the rear view and detail A: two toolless mounting buttons on the centre line, 31.22 [1.23] from each end and 1555 [61.22] apart (31.22 + 1555 + 31.22 = 1617.44, the strip's length). The removable mounting brackets the view draws (detail D) are not drawn.

sides.note: drawing - the side view draws the body 43.5 deep with the removable brackets and the retention comb on it and nothing built into the metal, so both sides are plain faces. The standing PDU's right side is the one the drawing shows.
